contexts.geographic_region: Namoi and Gwydir regions, northwest New South Wales
contexts.data_source: Foreground farm data from questionnaires and industry surveys; AusLCI and National Inventory Report emission factors
contexts.collection_method: Life Cycle Assessment, foreground data from 3 production seasons combined with published and survey data
contexts.functional_unit: kg CO2e per tonne of cotton lint
contexts.scenario_description: commercial nitrogen fertiliser rate of 255 kg N/ha reduced to 240 kg N/ha, all other inputs held at baseline
contexts.limitations: modelled result, not a field measurement, depends on the stated baseline assumptions holding

contexts.sample_or_population: Australian community members responding to the Voconiq national survey
contexts.data_source: Voconiq national online panel survey (n = 3,063), 30 October to 17 November 2025
contexts.collection_method: Voconiq annual national community trust survey
contexts.survey_question_text: The cotton industry in Australia uses water responsibly
contexts.limitations: single Likert-style agreement item, no margin of error stated in the source text

statistics.source_excerpt: In the more recent period (2014 - Oct 2019), there have been a further six cases that can positively be defined as occurring on a cotton property.
Since the previous review, two additional cases were identified to have occurred during this period, taking the total for the 2014-2019 period to eight.
statistics.note: same real-world period as the 2019 report's figure, revised upward after two more cases were confirmed

statistics.source_excerpt: In the more recent period (Oct 2019 - Dec 2023), there have been fewer than five cases on a cotton property.
statistics.note: value intentionally withheld by the source under its own ethics agreement, not a missing extraction

statistics.variable: life cycle greenhouse gas emissions reduction
statistics.source_excerpt: reducing N fertiliser rate from a commercial rate of 255 kg N/ha to 240 kg N/ha or 180 kg N/ha (2.6% and 13.2% emissions reduction)

statistics.variable: share of production from irrigated systems
statistics.source_excerpt: We assumed that 96% of production was from irrigated systems, with 85% of irrigation water pumped by diesel-powered irrigation pumps
statistics.note: a model input the authors assumed, not a measured outcome, kept distinct via record_type rather than treated as a finding

statistics.variable: community agreement that the cotton industry uses water responsibly
statistics.source_excerpt: More people agree this year than they have in any other year of the survey that the cotton industry uses water responsibly at 47% (Figure 4) compared to 42% in 2020.

statistics.variable: community agreement that the cotton industry uses water responsibly
statistics.note: same survey question as stat_voconiq_water_2025, a prior year's result restated for trend comparison, both share ctx_voconiq_water_responsibly rather than duplicating the question text and methodology
